status: offline research only; not deployed or GPU-tested
procedure: A versus B first; same neutral prompts and seeds, include multiple independent seeds and multi-turn histories.
Do not export or replay private user chats. User can perform separate phone confirmation voluntarily.
Only compare B versus C if repetition persists; 0.3 is an experimental value, not an author recommendation.
D changes multiple settings and is a package comparison, not single-factor causal evidence.
Keep context, quantization, engine and MTP unchanged in the first round.
Record actual effective request parameters, prompt/output tokens, finish_reason, DONE, TTFT and elapsed time.
Judge semantic completeness, repeated passages, language mixing, character consistency and sentence endings separately.
length is a limit stop, never count as a successful cure for repetition or premature endings.
Use a bounded test time/compute budget upon next explicit startup; no new paid instance during offline research.
Compare brief requests, detailed requests and a long-to-short transition in the SAME multi-turn conversation. Do not force a universal word/paragraph count.
Read-only offline preparation now. No GPU allocation or inference until a later explicit startup; no production setting changes implied by this plan.
Cold-control phase submits cache_prompt=false in every arm and alternates arm order across seeds; inspect returned cache_n, do not assume full determinism.
After candidate quality passes, separately test cache_prompt=true with identical case/session switching; never deploy cache_prompt=false as a speed optimization.
C versus C2 isolates penalty history window; B versus E tests DRY alone. Experimental values are not validated Scarlet recommendations.
No absolute maximum answer length target. Check concise response where appropriate AND sufficient detail where requested.
output_budget_policy: Do not introduce or lower a per-answer output cap as a verbosity/repetition fix. Preserve the existing client budget during comparisons; record its effective value. Any run stopped by safety/time/context budget is censored, not a naturally completed success.
objective: Context-appropriate length and natural completion without repetitive filler; shorter is not automatically better. Speed is not an optimization target in this round.
